fail_exit_code.description: The exit code to return when the njs script fails.

stack_size.description: The maximum stack size in bytes.

path_prefix.description: The path prefix for loading modules.

ignore_unhandled_promise_rejection.description: If true, ignores unhandled promise rejections.

load_as_es6_module.description: If true, loads the script as an ES6 module.

modules.description: A list of modules to load into the njs instance. Each item in the list is a flat map with 'name' (string) and 'path' (string).

items.description: Schema for items in the 'modules' list. Each item has 'name' (string, default: '') and 'path' (string, default: '').

items_name.description: The name of the module to load.

items_path.description: The path to the module file to load.

command.description: A string of JavaScript code to execute directly.
